title: Local Pride and Global Reach: Who Feels Represented by Gujarat Titans?
dek: Gujarat Titans carry a city's name and a squad drawn from around the world. The balance between local and overseas players shapes who feels represented.
excerpt: In the seasons where nationality data is reliable, overseas players have faced or bowled a measurable share of Gujarat Titans' deliveries. Local pride and global reach both have a basis on the field.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Players from {{ev:lp-countries}} countries have played for GT.
Overseas players faced or bowled {{ev:lp-os}} of the side's balls.
The figures cover the {{ev:lp-yrs}} of {{ev:lp-all}} seasons with reliable nationality data.

sections.heading: A City's Name, a World Squad
body: IPL franchises are rooted in a city but built from an international market. Fans at home see local heroes alongside overseas stars, and fans abroad follow their compatriots.
The CricField warehouse holds no survey, sentiment or social-media data, so it cannot measure what fans feel. It can measure what they have watched.

sections.heading: Who Has Represented the Franchise
body: Players from {{ev:lp-countries}} countries have played for Gujarat Titans. Overseas players faced or bowled {{ev:lp-os}} of the side's balls.
The chart tracks that overseas share season by season.

sections.heading: Local Heroes
body: The Indian share of the action is where local pride is built, although "local" often means national rather than from the franchise's own city or state; birthplace by state is not in the data.

sections.heading: Global Reach
body: Overseas players bring followings from their home countries. Measuring that reach would need audience data by country.

Nationality comes from CricField player-bio records and squad lists. Only the {{ev:lp-yrs}} of {{ev:lp-all}} seasons where it covers at least four-fifths of the balls are used, and within them it covers {{ev:lp-cover}}; squad-list nationality contains known errors.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Both Stories Are Real
body: Gujarat Titans have a measurable mix of Indian and overseas contributors. Local pride and global reach both rest on players who have actually played.
Who feels represented is a survey question.
